Strings.clamshellExplanation: “Keep going with the lid closed” sets the power plan's lid action to “Do nothing” while “Keep awake” is active, and restores your setting when the session ends, pauses or the app quits. If the app ever stops unexpectedly, the setting is restored the next time it starts. Prefer using it plugged in.
Strings.keepAwakeMouseJiggleCaption: During a session, moves the pointer one pixel and back at the chosen interval, so apps that watch for activity see some.
